description: MITRE ATT&CK to Cyber Kill Chain (CKC) mapping used by the STRIX detection pipeline. Extracted from apps/notebooks/preprocessing_dataset.ipynb and cross-checked against RL_agent/synthetic/data_loader.py (TACTIC_MAPPING + TECHNIQUE_MAPPING).

phase_priority.comment: Used when a row has multiple tactic/technique labels — pick the smallest number (earliest phase wins).

T1059.004.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

T1222.002.name: Linux File and Directory Permissions Modification

T1036.005.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location

T1548.003.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching

T1562.001.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

T1070.004.name: Indicator Removal on Host: File Deletion

tactic_name_to_ckc.comment: Used when the raw alert carries MITRE fields as human-readable names (lowercase, exact match). Applied to _source.rule.mitre.tactic.

technique_name_to_ckc.comment: Applied to _source.rule.mitre.technique. Exact match first, then substring fallback (first match in insertion order).
S4: command and scripting interpreter: unix shell
abuse elevation control mechanism: sudo and sudo caching
S5: linux and mac file and directory permissions modification
file and directory permissions modification: linux and mac file and directory permissions modification
masquerading: match legitimate name or location
impair defenses: disable or modify tools
S7: indicator removal on host: file deletion

resolution_rules.1_technique_over_tactic: When a row has both a technique and a tactic, the technique mapping wins. If no technique maps, fall back to tactic.
resolution_rules.2_earliest_phase_wins: When a row has multiple tactics or techniques, reduce to the one with the smallest phase_priority number (e.g., [S1,S4,S5] -> S1).
resolution_rules.3_name_exact_then_substring: For name-based technique mapping: try exact lowercase match first, then substring (first matching entry wins). For tactic names, only exact match is used.
resolution_rules.4_summary_column: The cyber_kill_chain_summary column is min(phase_priority) across the 4 derived columns (tactic_id, technique_id, tactic_name, technique_name).
resolution_rules.5_no_match_is_benign: Rows with NO matching MITRE information are treated as Benign (stage 0).

missing_tactics.TA0010: Exfiltration — not mapped; rows carrying only TA0010 fall through to Benign. Likely a bug; future work should assign to S7.
missing_tactics.TA0042: Resource Development — not mapped; likely belongs to S2 Weaponization.

known_gaps.stage_S2_unreachable: No rule ever outputs S2 Weaponization. The downstream models will never see this label from real data.

loader_missing_features.comment: RL_agent/synthetic/data_loader.py:97-133 only ports the ID-based dicts. The name-based mappings, substring fallback, technique-over-tactic precedence, and earliest-phase summary reduction are NOT present in the loader and must be re-implemented server-side for full parity with the notebook.
